title: My Brother’s Great Invention
subject: English
summary: “My Brother’s Great Invention” is an interesting story about a boy who is very creative and enjoys making new things. He uses his imagination and scientific knowledge to create an invention. His family members are surprised by his ideas and efforts. The story shows how curiosity, creativity and hard work can help us discover new things. It also teaches us that we should encourage young minds to think differently and try new experiments. The chapter teaches us that curiosity, imagination and determination are important for learning and making new inventions.
